description: Contains route adapter widgets for navigating between screens in a Flutter dating app frontend. Provides adapter classes for MatchesScreen and ChatScreen to be used in route configuration.

classes.name: MatchesRouteAdapter
classes.description: A stateless widget acting as an adapter for the MatchesScreen. It allows route referencing with potential for further customization or dependency injection.

classes.name: ChatRouteAdapter
classes.description: A stateless widget acting as an adapter for the ChatScreen, enabling its use in route configurations.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the adapter, returning the respective screen widget.
